Heat management is the job, around the clock
IAQ company profile
Empowering the digital future with precision, security and efficiency in data centre excellence.

Precision, data security, reliability and operational efficiency are the four the profile names. Cooling carries all four at once, which is why heat management sets the pace of the build rather than following it.

1
Absolute precision
2
Highest standards for data security, reliability and operational efficiency
3
Heat management
4
Energy efficiency and reduced environmental footprint
One accountable team, every system

Global demand for computing, data processing, storage and sharing keeps growing, and data centres are rising with it. They demand absolute precision and the highest standards of data security, reliability and operational efficiency.

Heat management is critical. We use advanced cooling technologies to improve energy efficiency and reduce the environmental footprint of each data centre.

Typical data centre scope
1
Chilled and condenser water piping
2
Cooling plant and heat rejection
3
Electrical distribution and controls integration
4
Pressure testing, flushing and commissioning

Cooling plant, distribution and controls run through the same six stages. Commissioning carries the weight: the load arrives on a fixed date, and the plant is proven against it.

No cleanroom class. A different bar entirely.

Cleanroom classification does not apply here, and every delivered data centre project is recorded as Not Applicable. The bar is set instead by the four things the sector is judged on: absolute precision, data security, reliability and operational efficiency.
